spec.rawSql:
select
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  max((data->>'active')::int8) as active,
  max((data->>'total')::int8) as total_db,
  max((data->>'idleintransaction')::int8) as idleintransaction,
  max((data->>'waiting')::int8) as waiting
from backends
where dbname = '$dbname' and $__timeFilter(time)
group by 1
order by 1

select
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  max((data->>'instance_total')::int8) as instance_total,
  max((data->>'max_connections')::int8) as max_connections
from backends
where dbname = '$dbname' and $__timeFilter(time)
group by 1
order by 1

spec.title: Connections Overview
spec.description:
- Total number of sessions established to this database. 
- Number of database sessions to this database that were terminated because connection to the client was lost.
- Number of database sessions to this database that were terminated by fatal errors.
- Number of database sessions to this database that were terminated by operator intervention.

spec.rawSql:
with sessions as (
  SELECT 
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  (data->>'sessions')::int8 as sessions,
  lag((data->>'sessions')::int8) over w as lag_sessions,
  (data->>'sessions_abandoned')::int8 as sessions_abandoned,
  lag((data->>'sessions_abandoned')::int8) over w as lag_sessions_abandoned,
  (data->>'sessions_fatal')::int8 as sessions_fatal,
  lag((data->>'sessions_fatal')::int8) over w as lag_sessions_fatal,
  (data->>'sessions_killed')::int8 as sessions_killed,
  lag((data->>'sessions_killed')::int8) over w as lag_sessions_killed
from db_stats 
where dbname = '$dbname' and $__timeFilter(time)
window w as (order by time)
)
select 
  time,
  sum(CASE WHEN sessions >= lag_sessions THEN sessions - lag_sessions ELSE sessions END) as established,
  sum(CASE WHEN sessions_abandoned >= lag_sessions_abandoned THEN sessions_abandoned - lag_sessions_abandoned ELSE sessions_abandoned END) as abandoned,
  sum(CASE WHEN sessions_fatal >= lag_sessions_fatal THEN sessions_fatal - lag_sessions_fatal ELSE sessions_fatal END) as fatal,
  sum(CASE WHEN sessions_killed >= lag_sessions_killed THEN sessions_killed - lag_sessions_killed ELSE sessions_killed END) as killed
from sessions 
group by time
order by 1

select
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  max(((CASE WHEN c >= c_lag THEN c - c_lag ELSE c END) + (CASE WHEN r >= r_lag THEN r - r_lag ELSE r END)) / extract(epoch from time - time_lag)) as "TPS"
from (
        select 
          (data->>'xact_commit')::int8 as c, lag((data->>'xact_commit')::int8) over w as c_lag,
          (data->>'xact_rollback')::int8 as r, lag((data->>'xact_rollback')::int8) over w as r_lag,
          time, lag(time) over w as time_lag
        from db_stats
        where dbname = '$dbname' and $__timeFilter(time)
        window w as (order by time)        
) x
where time > time_lag
group by 1
order by 1

select
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  max((CASE WHEN c >= c_lag THEN c - c_lag ELSE c END) / extract(epoch from time - time_lag)) as "QPS"
from (
        select 
          (data->>'calls')::int8 as c, lag((data->>'calls')::int8) over w as c_lag,
          time, lag(time) over w as time_lag
        from stat_statements_calls
        where dbname = '$dbname' and $__timeFilter(time)
        window w as (order by time)        
) x
where time > time_lag
group by 1
order by 1
